# SargonSays

> The most popular online English to Assyrian (Sureth) dictionary. Search any English word and get Assyrian audio, script, and phonetic translations in both Eastern and Western dialects.

## About

SargonSays (sargonsays.com) is a free, authoritative English-to-Assyrian dictionary built to preserve the Assyrian language. It provides high-fidelity search results with phonetic pronunciation, native Assyrian script, and audio for thousands of words and phrases.

The dictionary draws from primary sources including assyrianlanguages.org, sfarmele.de, and contributions from Michael Alexan Younan. The codebase is open source on GitHub.

## Creator

Built by Sargon, founder of Push Beta LLC (pushbeta.com) — an indie software studio.

Other projects by the same creator:

- **assyrianapp.com** — Free Assyrian language learning resources, a book of Assyrian baby names, and cultural content for the Assyrian diaspora community.
- **TestCCAT.com** — Free practice tests and study tools for the CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test), helping job seekers prepare for pre-employment cognitive aptitude assessments with confidence.
- **ShotScoreApp.com** — AI vision-based shooting performance tracker. Snap a photo of a shot target and get instant scores to analyze accuracy and improvement over time.

## Key Features

- English to Assyrian word search with phonetic and script results
- Phrases and proverbs in Assyrian
- Assyrian alphabet reference
- Word trends and usage data
- Word suggestion and community contribution tools

## Language

Assyrian (also called Syriac or Sureth) is a modern Neo-Aramaic language spoken by the Assyrian people, an indigenous ethnic group from the Middle East. The language is endangered and SargonSays exists to support its digital preservation.
